# Gate 1 package - BI-PF-1511
**Backlog authority follow-up: runtime diagnostics and quotas**

## Plain language
**What/why:** Startup gauge, fixed statement timeout, reservation id echo, and ID-space quota need hardening. -> Runtime diagnostics/quotas for authority/reservations.

## Gate 1.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 1.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=deepseek-v4.1-flash sha=80a5bc535aaf)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 12 (BLOCKER 3 / MAJOR 4 / MINOR 3 / NIT 2); dispositions: actioned 12; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLOCKER | CL-010 unmet: proof plan names only AC-1 as the failing test; no current-run red proof is attached for AC-2 timeout or AC-4 exhaustion at the real runtime entrypoint, so AC-2's failing-then-passing requirement is not demonstrated. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |
| 2 | BLOCKER | CL-011 unmet: design asserts tenant binding but provides no proof/test that runtime DB roles are `NOSUPERUSER`/`NOBYPASSRLS`; RLS posture remains prose only. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |
| 3 | BLOCKER | AC-4 gap: design specifies fixed 409 plus counter/alarm, but no fixed safe reason code/body is defined or asserted; the acceptance criterion for a safe exhaustion reason is not demonstrably covered. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |
| 4 | MAJOR | `ops/prometheus/backlog-authority.rules.yml` has no promtool validation, alert threshold/`for` duration, or control evidence; the AC-4 alarm path is unproven. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |
| 5 | MAJOR | `PF_EDP_DB_TIMEOUT` wiring is described, but the design lacks an explicit default/range/missing-config contract and startup preflight, so misconfiguration may surface only at request time. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |
| 6 | MAJOR | AC-1 bounded-reason enforcement lacks a single shared allowlist/table tying metric labels, logs, and alert rules together; reason-label drift remains a live risk. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |
| 7 | MAJOR | No on-startup schema/role preflight is defined despite `migration_missing`/`row_missing` being fail-closed taxonomy entries. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |
| 8 | MINOR | `go/edpsvc/go.mod` is listed as affected without dependency rationale; verify no unintended module change. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |
| 9 | MINOR | Runbook update is planned but has no acceptance check that operators can use the new reason codes and exhaustion alert. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |
| 10 | MINOR | Coverage uses mixed reservation-echo test names (`TestAuthorityResponseEchoesReservationID` vs `TestBacklogReserveEchoesIDWithDB`), reducing traceability. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |
| 11 | NIT | AC-1 says "failure gauge" while coverage describes a reason counter plus `last_request_ok` gauge; align metric naming across design, tests, and docs. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |
| 12 | NIT | The proof/evidence entries use `candidate` placeholders and test names rather than attached artifacts; make evidence capture explicit. | ACTIONED | Fixed in design pack/evidence; see engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1511/ and design_pack coverage. |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Direction is sound and scoped, but the design is not Gate-1.5 ready: red proof, runtime RLS role proof, and the AC-4 safe-reason contract are incomplete.
  Top risks are unverified fail-closed exhaustion behavior, unproven RLS posture, and an alert rule that may not fire or route correctly.
